# Moukey v4.0.3

**A small fix release for v4.0.1.** It fixes a Gesture Swipe tap action that looked unset, adds a Debug mode switch to Settings, and makes a page that came up blank repair itself. It also covers the changes of v4.0.2, which was not released separately.

## 🧭 Gesture Swipe

- **The tap action is shown again.** A tap action saved for a Gesture Swipe button, for example "Close tab", showed as "Do Nothing" after you reopened the window, although it still worked. The device page now reads it back correctly. The same applies to the tap action of Back, Forward, Middle and Mode shift.

## 🛠️ Settings and stability

- **Debug mode switch in Settings.** Settings → General now has a "Debug mode" switch. It shows the debug panel (event log, record and clear) under the device image on the mouse and keyboard pages. It was only reachable from the tray menu before, which made it easy to miss.
- **A blank page repairs itself.** The Settings, Haptics and Actions Ring pages could come up empty and stay that way until Moukey was restarted. If a page fails to build, Moukey now logs the error and rebuilds the page the next time you open it or click its entry in the sidebar again.

## 📝 Notes

- Tested on Windows with automated tests. The blank-page repair has not been reproduced on a real session, because the glitch itself could not be triggered on demand; it only retries a page that is empty or failed to load.
